## Description

Blend market-implied prior returns with explicit views and confidence levels, then optimize allocations.

## Where it may fit

Strategic multi-asset allocation when investors have calibrated views and want weights less driven by raw historical means.

## Vehicles

Multi-asset funds, endowments, wealth-management and ETF portfolios.

## Required data

Market-cap weights, covariance matrix, risk-aversion parameter, view matrix, view estimates/confidence and constraints.

## Caveats

Outputs depend on prior, view construction, covariance and constraints; it is an allocation framework, not a timing signal.
